title: The circle: where all of this leads

outline.heading: Why a circle rather than another app

points.text: What follows honestly: the evidence supports not "the group as such" but a living person in the loop.

outline.heading: How to assemble a circle that stands a chance

points.text: If you have no frame of your own for a meeting, there's a ready one: the Group Insight Game (GII) — six cards, four steps, one turn each around the circle.

outline.heading: How to choose a school or a course
